title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
summary: Across 392 live ladder games, the account rating rose from 6,000 to 14,007; the paper separates 96 client failures from agent-play performance. The result is a single study account on a live game ladder; leader-board estimates and client failures are explicitly outside the bounded policy-performance claim.
ai_technology: LLM research agents improve the game simulator/opponents; a transformer policy trained with PPO chooses play actions.
